associations.rationale: The displayed type only presents E6Lattice as a set of rational coordinate vectors; its defining coordinate equalities are opaque.
The formal type identifies a simple-root adjacency matrix with the E6 Dynkin adjacency, not the requested coordinate-equality realization of the E6 sublattice.
